fact: In March 2026 an interview states that Bank of Algeria regulations 24-01, 24-04 and 25-02 under law 23-09 set user and depositor protection rules for payment service providers, that no private provider was yet licensed, and that unlicensed activity can draw administrative or judicial sanctions.
title: Prestataires de services de paiement, le rappel à l'ordre d'un banquier
